cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm ready for our audition results. Why are you breathing like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Four in, six out. I like to arrive already regulated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Lend me your pen; my support network deserves advance notice.
